listing.name: Card Aging
listing.description:
Easily spot which cards on your board have not been active lately with the Card Aging Power-Up for Trello. As cards fade (Regular mode) or yellow and tear (Pirate mode) you can see which tasks and projects may have fallen by the wayside and should be archived or need a status report, making sure your boards stay relevant and up-to-date.

- See the activity (or lack of activity) of Trello cards in a glance.

- Choose from Regular mode or Pirate mode… Aargh!

- Card inactivity age thresholds are 1, 2, and 4 weeks.

- Open a card to see when it was last updated.

- Updated cards will turn back to their normal state.

listing.description:
Bring perspective to due dates with the Calendar Power-Up for Trello. Whether you are planning a conference, managing an editorial calendar, or organizing a family vacation, the Calendar Power-Up let’s you display cards with due dates in a weekly or monthly calendar view. listing.description:
--------------------------------------------------------------------------

🔎 Want a replacement for the old Custom Fields powerup on the free plan, this is it.

👉🏼 Amazing Fields supports creating and using fields with the Trello free and paid plans.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------

**All the things you always wanted in custom fields but didn’t know to ask**

As long time users of Trello, we wanted to break out of the limits of the standard Custom Fields powerup.  We wanted all the features we have grown to expect from other tools like **customized formatting**, **conditional styling**, **selectable icons**, and even **progress bars**. We built this powerup to meet our needs and yours as well.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Join 1000's of happy users**

"_I can't believe there aren't more apps that offer these features -- so well done and thank you so much for developing this!!_" - **Cathi B**

![Status](https://app.amazingpowerups.com/status/amazing-fields)

--------------------------------------------------------------------------

![Overview Image](https://static.amazingpowerups.com/images/amazing_fields_guide/amazing_fields_overall_guide-opt.png)

It includes everything you could wish for:

   * **Show fields per card** - choose which fields are shown per card
   * **Number formatting** - currency, scientific, percents, accounting and more
   * **Date formatting** - choose everything about how you want to show the date
   * **Progress bars** - use multiple styles to track progress
   * **Checkbox styles** - select from several types of checkboxes
   * **Field display options** - show on front or back with optional labels
   * **Conditional coloring** - change the badge color based upon field values
   * **Reorder fields** - easily reorder fields live for full control
   * **Advanced editors** - go beyond the basic field editors
   * And more… - send [new ideas][1]

If there is anything you want and don’t see, [contact us][1] to suggest something new.

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Capabilities

You can define all the field types you always could with the Custom Fields powerup.  Once you set the fields and types you want, you can open the cards to collect all the additional information you want

   * **Text fields** - collect key information that you need for each card.
   * **Numbers** - track metrics like story points, counts, or any other numbers
   * **Checkbox** - support tracking any on/off style values
   * **Dates** - collect key dates and times to show on the cards
   * **Dropdown** - create a list of preset values and let users choose one


## Customized Fields Shown Per Card

Make every card just the way you want it.  You can choose which fields to show per card.  No more defining a large number of fields and having to see them on cards where they are not relevant.  Instead, you can define all the fields you need for the board and choose which ones you want for each card.  You can setup which fields are shown by default and then override them as needed per card.  When you copy a card or use a card template, it keeps track of the fields you want to show.

![Field Filter Example](https://static.amazingpowerups.com/images/amazing_fields_guide/custom_fields_per_card_guide-opt.png)


## Date Formatting 📅

You are able to choose exactly how you want your dates to show on cards.  Dates and times are show in local internationalized formats.  Over 40 different variations are supported.  Let us know if there is another option that you need.

![Date Formatting Example](https://static.amazingpowerups.com/images/amazing_fields_guide/date-fields-linux-opt.png)

## Number Formatting 🧮

Select from any combination of number formatting.  All numbers are displayed in the correct location international format, and you can even change the number of decimal places in the number.

![Number Formatting Example](https://static.amazingpowerups.com/images/amazing_fields_guide/number-fields-linux-opt.png)

## Currency Support 💰

Choose to format the number using international currencies and formatting.

## Accounting Format 🧾

Supports styling in accounting format to display negative numbers clearly and support accountants on your team.

## Progress Bars 📊

Have you ever wanted to see progress towards a goal on your cards?  Well now you can with progress bars.  You can configure the style, width, range and more.

![Progress Bars Example](https://static.amazingpowerups.com/images/amazing_fields_guide/progress-bar-fields-linux-opt.png)

## Custom Progress Bar Styles

Amazing Fields includes 10+ styles of progress bars, but our users told us they wanted more.  So we added support for custom progress bars.  The configuration is a bit more complex of you choose to go custom, but it allows you to create anything you can imagine.

## Customized Checkboxes ☑️

No more being restricted to a single boring check style.  Select from a wide range of options.  You can choose to only show a checkbox when it is checked and to hide it otherwise.  Every aspect of how you show it is up to you to choose.  Let us know if there are more styles or options we can add to support your use case.

![Checkboxes Example](https://static.amazingpowerups.com/images/amazing_fields_guide/boolean-fields-linux-opt.png)

## Dropdown Lists

When you just want a field that lets you select from a preset list of items.  It is easy to define a list of choices along with colors to use to decorate the choices.  Very simple, but very useful for things like card tags, workflow stages, categorization of items, etc.

![List Example](https://static.amazingpowerups.com/images/amazing_fields_casts/list_support_cast.gif)


## Field Display Options 🕵️

You can choose where and how you want your fields to be displayed.  Choose if they should show on the front, the back, or both.  Also choose if the field should be labeled or stand alone.

![Display Options Example](https://static.amazingpowerups.com/images/amazing_fields_casts/display_options_cast.gif)

## Conditional Badge Coloring 🎨

You don't have to use the same boring colors for the badges that show your fields on a card.  You can define conditional formatting rules to change the badge color based upon the value of your field.  This lets you do all types of amazing things like color progress bars based upon percentage completed, highlight text fields based upon content, monitor key dates, and highlight key checkbox values.  If there is something you want a rule for that isn't supported, [let us know][1] and we will add it for you.

![Conditional Coloring Example](https://static.amazingpowerups.com/images/amazing_fields_casts/rule_coloring_cast.gif)

## Custom Editors

The editors on the back of the cards are customized and styled based upon the type of the field.

No more basic ugly editors.  Now even the editors are Amazing.  This lets you immediately see any conditional formatting and makes it much easier to visually distinguish all the fields.  When you change a value on a progress bar you can see it immediately.  If you click on a checkbox you see the custom styled icons.  Everything should just work the way you expect and look just right.

You can set how wide the editors should be and change the way they are labeled.  This lets you set up the editors on the back of the card to look exactly like you want them for your workflow.

We think this feature makes fields much more powerful because they now have the same pop on the back as they do in the front.

![Custom Editors](https://static.amazingpowerups.com/images/amazing_fields_guide/custom-editors-linux-opt.png)

## Customize Permissions Per Field

If you have a workflow where you want to hide some fields from non-administrators or restrict who can edit a field, this feature is for you.  We build on top of the existing Trello permissions model to let you determine what types of users can view and/or edit each field.  You can require a user to be an admin, a normal member, or an observer.  You can further decide if this restricts being able to view the data or edit the data.  This enables a whole new class of advanced workflows for sharing data across your boards.


## Exporting Card Data 📋

Amazing Fields allows you to export all the cards on the board including their field data to a CSV file.  This can be loaded in Excel or other spreadsheet software for further processing and analysis of your data.  You can use this to export both Amazing Fields data or simply to export your normal card data.


--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Getting Started
==================

There are a few short steps to get started using the Amazing Fields PowerUp.

**1. Enable the powerup on your board**

   Click on the add button at the **top of this page** to add the powerup to a board.

   ![Enable Powerup](https://static.amazingpowerups.com/images/amazing_fields_guide/enable_powerup_process-opt.png)

**2. Open Amazing Fields PowerUp settings**

   Go to the board where Amazing PowerUps is installed and open the settings panel by clicking on the "Fields" button in the upper right of the board.

   ![Open Settings](https://static.amazingpowerups.com/images/amazing_fields_guide/setup_open_settings-opt.png)

**3. Authorize access to Trello**

   The Amazing Fields PowerUp needs your permission to talk to Trello and interact with your boards.  On the general settings page click on "Authorize with Trello".

   ![Authorize with Trello](https://static.amazingpowerups.com/images/amazing_fields_guide/setup_auth_trello-opt.png)

**4. Setup the fields you want**

   In the settings panel, can click "Add" to create the fields you want.  Select the new field to edit the details such as field type and configuration.  Explore this panel for all the options that are available.

   ![Add Field](https://static.amazingpowerups.com/images/amazing_fields_guide/setup_add_field-opt.png)


Templates / Examples
====================

Take a look at these templates to get a feel for what is possible and see some ways to use Amazing Fields.  To see the field settings used, simply click on "Create board from template" after you open the links and then take a look at the Amazing Fields powerup settings by clicking on the "Fields" board button at the top of the board.

   * Feature Examples
      * [Field Features](https://trello.com/b/xlQbIsPC)
      * [Progress Bars](https://trello.com/b/0qk7eYed)
   * Usage Examples
      * [Personal Todo](https://trello.com/b/WA8LoWrA)


Contact Us
==========

To get help or suggest a new features, please contact us directly at [support@amazingpowerups.com][1].  We love feedback and will get back to you as quickly as possible.


Links
=====
   * [Product Page](https://amazingpowerups.com/product/amazing-fields/)
   * [Amazing PowerUps Blog](https://amazingpowerups.com/blog/)
   * [Privacy Policy](https://amazingpowerups.com/privacy-policy/)

listing.name: Processes for Trello
listing.description:
Lost in interdependent cards and checklists? Tired of reinventing the wheel over and over again on recurring tasks? 

#Get Back Control Over Your Team Routines#

The [Processes for Trello](https://processesfortrello.com#pk_campaign=Trello-Listing) Power-Up allows your team to manage **task dependencies** and implement and iteratively refine effective team **workflows for recurring tasks**:

+ Attach processes with sub-tasks to any Trello card
+ Any sub-task is represented by its own Trello card
+ Create processes from scratch or define templates (including file attachments, assigned members, labels, due dates, etc.)
+ Easily navigate between tasks and sub-tasks with one click
+ Create temporal dependencies between sub-tasks (subsequent tasks hold until all preceding tasks are done)
+ Adapt process instances any time (add, remove, or change order of sub-tasks)
+ Drag and drop support for automated state updates
+ Build with a focus on simplicity: Simple to learn, fun to use


#Support and Contact#

If you have any question or feedback, take a look at our [FAQs](https://processesfortrello.com/#faqs) or reach out to us via our [contact form](https://processesfortrello.com/#contact).


#How to Use#
##1. Attach Process##

+ Break down complex work items into multiple tasks
+ Have a dedicated card automatically created for each task
+ Create processes from scratch or via templates (see below)
+ Adjust processes any time by adding, removing, or reordering tasks

![Basic Usage](https://p4tcdn.web.app/screens/1_basics_white.gif)


##2. Navigate Tasks and Update Progress##

+ Grasp progress of tasks and process execution at a glance
+ Navigate with one click between processes and tasks
+ Mark tasks as Open, Started or Done for transparency and to avoid double work

Good habits fuel your life success. Organize your perfect routine, track progress and free your mind for the most important things!

## About Power-Up

Habit Tracker by UpgradeYourBrain is a fully Trello-integrated habit tracker. Main tracker objective: to circumvent the inertia of the psyche and help performing new actions regularly. This tracker is perfect for those who use Trello for self-organization.


The main difference between this tracker and the rest is its full compatibility with personal task management systems (like GTD) that have a “today's action list” or “next action list”. Habits will be added as cards to this list at the time you specify. You can also enable notifications for habits. Thus, you will not forget to perform these actions and you will not have to spend extra time filling out the tracker!


Due to its features, the tracker can be used for both typical habits, such as “Get up at 6:00”, and also for less frequent or work tasks, for example, “Plan for a month” or “Calculate quarterly bonuses.” That is, you can use it to remind of repeated tasks, and table data aggregation by weeks and months will show the progress more clearly.

This tracker will also help organize your morning ritual or daily routine if you use bullet journal system. In general, trello with this power-up can replace a paper bullet journal.

1. Each habit is a card. 
2. You determine when and in which list copies of this card will be created. 
3. By moving these copies to the "Done" list, you indicate to the tracker which habits you are following.

listing.name: Streak - habit tracker
listing.description:
Create new habits with Streak by tracking your completion rate using Trello cards, and be motivated to keep that streak going!

* See how your habits are tracking at a glance with your current streak on the front of each card
* Use the calendar inside each card to track your streak
* For more indepth notes, you can allow comments on your card to count towards your streak too 

This Power-Up is 100% free! To get started, open a Trello card and press the enable button on the settings pop-up.


![Streak example image](https://emgoto.github.io/streak/img/streak-example.png) 


### How are streaks calculated?
All the calculation is done based on the "days a week" setting you assign in the settings for each card.

To give an example, if you have it set to 7 days a week and today is a Saturday:

* If you've completed the habit Monday through to Saturday your streak will be 6
* If you've completed the habit Monday through to Friday your streak will be 5, but it will be a yellow color to warn you that if you don't complete it today (Saturday), you will lose the streak
* If you've completed the streak Monday through to Thursday your streak will be 0

If you've got the streak set to 6 days a week, 5, etc. then you can skip more days and it will still count as a "streak" (until you've skipped too many days).

You can also set the streak to 0, and it will track any day without ever breaking your streak.

If you have any other questions or feature requests, feel free to send the developer a [tweet](https://twitter.com/emma_goto) or email at hello@emgoto.com
